info.title: HeyCreator API
info.description: Influencer discovery and campaign management platform API. Connects brands with creators across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitter, and Facebook.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Email verification, password reset, OAuth, and role detection

tags.name: Search & Discovery
tags.description: Hybrid search across Firestore database and live social media APIs

tags.name: Profiles
tags.description: Unified influencer profile management (create, read, update, delete)

tags.name: Users & Creators
tags.description: User data, global creator discovery, and export

tags.name: Utility
tags.description: Image proxy, metrics, pricing, and dashboard helpers

post.summary: Check email existence and verification status
post.description: Checks if an email address exists in Firebase Auth and whether it has been verified. Used during login to detect unverified accounts.

exists.description: Whether email exists in Firebase Auth

post.summary: Check email verification status by UID

post.description: Fetches user role (influencer or brand) from Firestore by email. Used for role-aware password reset redirects.
Resends the email verification link to the user. Requires the user's Firebase UID.
Updates the email address for a user (primarily for Instagram OAuth users who need to set an email).
Handles Instagram OAuth callback. Exchanges authorization code for access token, creates or updates user in Firebase, and returns a custom token.

code.description: Instagram authorization code from OAuth redirect

customToken.description: Firebase custom token for client-side sign-in

get.summary: Check if Instagram token needs refresh

post.description: Searches for influencers using a hybrid strategy: first queries the Firestore database for fast cached results, then falls back to live social media APIs (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitter, Facebook) if results are insufficient. Includes relevance scoring, quality filtering, and deduplication.

liveSearch.description: Force live API calls (skip database cache)

post.description: Advanced search with 15+ filters including platform, location, followers range, engagement rate, categories, and more. Supports pagination.

Creates a new unified influencer profile from search results. Saves to Firestore with linked social accounts, combined metrics, and influence score. Uses `primaryAccountKey` (platform:username) for deduplication.

get.description: Fetches all unified profiles for the authenticated user from Firestore.

put.description: Update a unified profile. Supports adding/removing linked accounts and updating profile details.

get.description: Fetches all influencer profiles for the authenticated user. Supports filtering by status.

post.description: Creates a new campaign. Requires brand role. Supports draft mode (partial data) and full creation with validation.

get.description: Fetches campaigns based on user role. Brands see their own campaigns; creators see published campaigns they can apply to.

patch.description: Partially updates a campaign. Brand must own the campaign.

delete.description: Deletes a campaign. Brand must own the campaign.

post.description: Publishes a draft campaign, making it visible to creators. Validates all required fields before publishing.

get.description: Fetches applications with role-based filtering. Brands see applications to their campaigns; creators see their own applications.

post.description: Submit an application to a published campaign. Requires creator role.
Invites a creator to a campaign. Requires brand role.

get.description: Fetches deliverables filtered by campaign or application. At least one filter is required.

post.description: Submits a content deliverable for a campaign application. Requires creator role.

get.description: Fetches all creator lists for the authenticated brand.

delete.description: Deletes a creator list and removes all creator references.

get.description: Fetches all campaign invitations for the authenticated creator.
Fetches a single invitation with campaign details. Supports accept/reject actions.
Fetches user profile data including Instagram token information.
Fetches creators from the global influencers collection for brand discovery.

post.description: Exports a list of creators to CSV or JSON format.
Runs 8 concurrent enrichment methods (7 API + 1 extraction) to gather comprehensive Instagram profile data. Optionally saves results to Firebase Storage and updates the Firestore profile.

cachedProfileData.description: Cached search result to skip redundant calls

profile.description: Merged profile data from all methods

get.description: Server-side image proxy to bypass CORS restrictions for social media profile pictures. Supports retry logic, forced IPv4, and CDN fallback via weserv.nl.
Returns recommended creators for the brand dashboard based on activity and preferences.

BearerAuth.description: Firebase Authentication ID token. Obtain by calling `firebase.auth().currentUser.getIdToken()`.

UserIdHeader.name: x-user-id
UserIdHeader.description: Development fallback: Firebase UID passed directly as header. Not for production use.

BadRequest.description: Bad request — validation error or missing fields

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid authentication token
